Anthracnose.quote: Dark-brown to black, sunken spots on the peel of infected fruits

Cigar_End_Rot.quote: an ash grey wrinkled lesion similar to the burnt end of a cigar

Cordana_Leaf_Spot.quote: Typical symptoms of this disease appear as oval, pale brown spots, and as long strips of light brown necrosed tissue sometimes extending from the leaf margins to the midrib.

Panama_Disease.quote: The first visible banana fusarium wilt symptoms are stunted growth, leaf distortion, and yellowing, and wilt along the edges of mature, lower leaves.
The leaves gradually collapse and droop from the plant, eventually drying up completely.
